title: Secret read from the environment in Go (go)
description: The code reads a credential from the environment with os.Getenv. Environment values are inherited by every child process and appear in process listings and dumps, so the secret outlives the code that needed it.
remediation: Load the secret from a restricted file or manager, for example a 0600 secret file or a secret manager, and keep it out of the environment.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the read without knowing whether the value is a secret.
